summary: Two unnamed male hikers aiming for the Keyhole Route followed headlamp lights and veered onto technical terrain at the base of the Diamond on Longs Peak east face, becoming stuck on a ledge; a Colorado Mountain School guide roping up nearby radioed for rescue; RMNP rangers roped-lowered both men ~600 ft to safety
location: Base of the Diamond, east face of Longs Peak
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers (NPS SAR)
notes: Outside Online 2012-08-17 (via Daily Camera) parent-opened run 633. Fills the zero-row year 2012 for Longs Peak. 2012-08-14 verified Tuesday.
